notes:
Checked the 57 edits against work/book-2.json, applied in list order to a copy (scratchpad: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-ren-theories/ab4fc732-b2ac-420a-aa49-cf63c999271c/scratchpad/edits-final.json). Each find occurs exactly once in its field when applied. All 57 apply. No find contains 域之兼 or 族之兼, so the list can go into work/round4-edits.json, which ROUNDS already lists and which runs before global-replacements.json.

WHAT I CHANGED FROM THE EDITOR'S LIST (3 edits; the other 54 are kept as written)
- 七·八: the editor's 「到达须在机之前」 has no subject and does not say what is open. The G9 gap (agents/revise-C17.json, map-C17.json) is this: if the source has not reached the reader by the juncture, the reader's step at the juncture cannot vary with the source. New text: 「读者于机处所行之步要随源而异，源须在机之前及于读者（⟦八·十五⟧；…）」. The answer half is already proved in 八·十五, so the reference marks what is proved and what is open. 源, 读者 and 答 are the role words of 八·十四/八·十五. 行 as a verb is the usage of this 條's own 經.
- 十二·二十三: 「恢复不依赖对对方是否也与之计算」 (with a doubled 对) → 「恢复不依赖计算对方是否也与」. Same content.
- 凡·十三: 「其后所推出之辞仍然」 → 「自新据所推出之辞仍然」. lemma_throughout is about every claim derived from the enlarged basis.

COVERAGE (grepped title, body, intro, duizhao and head of every 條)
- Every 所出 left after the edits is a lineage use, the quotation 「夫迹，履之所出」 (C01:DUIZHAO and 一·八), or the note in 十五·五 that refers to the name. The lineage uses are: 四·十一, 二·十六, 十一·十八 (share_rises_through and descent_exhausted concern parents and descent, checked in the Lean), 十三·二十二, the C12/C13/C14 intros, C12:DUIZHAO, and all of 篇十三.
- Every 回应 left is a gloss of 应: 八·十八, 九·十, 十一·二 (twice), and 十一·七 (in 应域（回应闭包…）).
- Only 十六·十二 uses the intervention sense, and all of its uses are covered. 十六·十一 compares moves (LiftBetter), so 动 is exact there.
- Edits that bring in other table names do so on purpose: 辞, 与/取/共取, 动, 果, 策, 域. 方 appears only inside 方式, which the book already uses six times, once in a 經. 读 appears only inside 读者, the role word. No replacement contains 驳, 报, 所自 or 入.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE AS A BODY EDIT
(a) The title of 凡·十三 cannot be changed by a round edit, because rounds reach body, INTRO, DUIZHAO and HEAD only, and book.py's retitle renames parts only. Add {"find":"所出与据","replace":"所推与据"} to work/global-replacements.json. In book-2 the string occurs only in that title.
(b) Rows in work/names-decisions.tsv (rendered into appendix 一):
- 可介: in 所名 and 注, 「一方可介一回应」 → 「一方可介一所可为者」 (in 所名, the 注's 新组合 sentence, and 「经中写…」).
- 由: 「一方于一回应」 → 「一方于一所可为者」 (twice); 「A、D 之所出」 → 「A、D 之结论」 (twice); 「于此回应有由」 → 「于此所可为者有由」.
- 據: 「推导之所出之诸辞」 → 「推导所从出之诸辞」 (twice); 「诸律所出之前提」 → 「诸律所从出之前提」.
- 得: 「则所出者或阙或得」 → 「则所给之值或阙或得」.
- 狀值: 「所出之值皆其状之 f 值」, 「于域中所出者皆其状之状值」 and 「与所出之值方向相反」 → 所给之值 in each.
- 規: 「C15 之回应 R」 → 「C15 之所可为者 R」.
- 出者: the line saying C16 should rewrite 「所出者」 is now settled; update it or drop it.
- 同類積小: 所名 → 「FR（finite responsiveness）」.
- 取法 (checked): in 「经他者实际回应之学」, 回应 is not RespondsTo. In ResponseLearning it is the teacher's answer to a query (send_delivers). It should be reworded, for example 「经他者实答之学」.
- 所留: its 注 quotes the old 纲 text 「其所出之域所留开者」 as a record of an earlier change. It is a quotation, but it could be updated to 「其各自之域所开者」.
- Keep: 應, 相應, 應域, 應式, 報, 環節 and 一偏 (their 回应 is 应 or its gloss); 共對; 子變, 率, 擇項, 無損益, 代, 在場, 下游, 世, 所自 (all lineage); 所履 (a quotation).

FLAGGED, OUTSIDE THE TWO STRINGS
- 应 in a second sense: 十三·二十一 (取法: 「经他者实应之学」, 「无应则…」, 「其应被取者」), C12:INTRO 「学经他者之实应」 and C12:DUIZHAO 「经实应而学」 use 应 for the teacher's answer, not ExchangeLaw.RespondsTo. Fixing this needs the 取法 definition and its 所名 changed together. 应对 in NEW-11 and 十二·二十二 is a compound and was left alone.
- 所给 now covers both 'given (data)' and 'what a reading gives'. The book already used both senses before this pass (十二·十一 法之所给; 纲·二 读此积所给者). The 經 of 九·十九 now uses 所给 in one sense only. Its 說 still has both (所给之截面, 所给之资料).
- The editor's list of 出于 in non-lineage senses stands; the 經 cases are the most at risk: 四·十三, 四·二十六, 四·二十七, 纲·一, NEW-7.
